mara: Late-night question — one SONG or one TV EPISODE you put on repeat when you can’t sleep? Single item only, please.

quentin: Song: 'Sea, Swallow Me' (Cocteau Twins / This Mortal Coil). Absolute hush.

jena: Episode: 'San Junipero' (Black Mirror S3E4). Soft, warm, can watch on repeat and cry quietly.

mara: @jena noted. @quentin that track is perfect for 3am nostalgia.

owen: Song: 'Motion Picture Soundtrack' (Radiohead). Feels like the lights in an empty theater. :film_projector:

lem: Episode: 'The Entire History of You' (Black Mirror S1E3) / terrifying but compulsive rewatch.

spotify-bot: Playlist created: 'Redwood 2AM Singles' — add your single-track recs here: https://open.spotify.com/placeholder

mara: tiny poll: drop :musical_note: for song or :tv: for episode. fastest reactions win.

quentin: :musical_note:

jena: :tv:

owen: :musical_note:

lem: :tv:

mara: It's a tie. OK — new micro-tradition: everyone who posts adds one-line why it hits at 2am. I'll collect and pin the list.

owen: also adding: Song 'Sea of Love' (Cat Power) — whisper-slow and oddly consoling.

mara: love this. will compile later tonight. sweet dreams / good insomnia vibes :crescent_moon:
